note: The strongest difference was in 06-api-keys: when the auth guard broke the existing /todos tests, Y minted an in-memory key in each file's beforeEach and left the spec-05 assertions exactly as written (Y.diff:333-339), whereas X rewrote them — AC-05-5 now asserts the 401 body instead of the empty list (X.diff:395), AC-05-4 lost its POST /todos step (X.diff:378-382), the AC-05-2 fixture was renamed from `keys` to `other` (X.diff:352), and one assertion was pasted twice (X.diff:394,397). Specs 04 and 05 were near-ties on implementation (the limiters are byte-equivalent in logic); the deciding factors there were traceability (full AC ids in test names), strictness (exact call-sequence vs findIndex), and the inline require('./todos') inside createApp (05 Y.diff:33), with the one unstable call being 04's architecture, where X's minimal-touch setHeader and Y's single headers object each looked cleaner depending on which was read first.
